title: Abelian hypercover totals invert bounded-below quasi-isomorphisms
statement: Let U be a simplicial object over a pro-etale X-object W with affine weakly contractible terms. A quasi-isomorphism of strictly bounded-below complexes of abelian sheaves is carried by the abelian hypercover total [def-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-hypercover-total] to a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 09A2 and 0946; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Constructible sheaves, Lemma 5.3(1)

proof.text: Choose a common strict lower bound. Exact term evaluation makes every nonnegative simplicial column map a quasi-isomorphism; extension isomorphisms identify it with the corresponding bicomplex column.
Negative simplicial columns are zero, and coefficient terms below the common bound are zero. Apply bounded-below total-column comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem abelianHypercoverTotal_map_quasiIso_of_weaklyContractible
    (haff : ∀ p : ℕ, IsAffine (U _⦋p⦌).left.left)
    (hweak : ∀ (p : ℕ) (F G : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G),
      Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op (U _⦋p⦌).left)))
    (E F : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf (topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (f : E ⟶ F) (hf : QuasiIso f.hom) :
    QuasiIso ((abelianHypercoverTotal X W U).map f.hom)
